name: @swao/module-powerbi
description: SWAO BI-export module (Community tier): the `export` command (CSV star schema + NDJSON + XLSX bundle for PowerBI) plus its ExportBiScreen and the bundled .pbit PowerBI templates (ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0577). BI export is ungated; the .pbit templates are public artefacts. The only tier gate is the runtime `requireTier('enterprise', { feature: 'export --portfolio' })` on the --portfolio flag (the portfolio data emission, not the template). The host injects its SWAO version (branding is host-only) into the screen.
